overall_strategy_summary: Fiserv is a payments and banking technology infrastructure giant serving banks, credit unions, and merchants. The firm processes 90 billion transactions annually. Key strategic moves: FIUSD stablecoin launch (Solana, with Paxos/Circle/PayPal/Mastercard), INDX real-time settlement platform, Finxact cloud-native core banking, Clover POS expansion (entering Japan with SMCC), StoneCastle acquisition for deposit network. CEO-level embrace of stablecoins and digital assets as next-generation payments infrastructure. Strong embedded finance positioning.
